conditioning.<log>.n_complaints / n_imag: REPAIR-pool D1 complaints (decoder v2) of the log, and their split by probe type
conditioning.<log>.[stacked.]median_Gamm: Gamma / gamma of the Gram matrix of the contributions scaled to unit diagonal, over the complaints; no prefix: at the last prompt key (ONE key); 'stacked.': the A answer-predicting keys stacked
conditioning.<log>.Gamma_over_gamma_is_o: true iff the ratio at the last prompt key is the same number for every complaint (at one key it is the ratio of the cosine matrix of the write vectors u_i)
conditioning.<log>.[stacked.]median_gamm: extreme eigenvalues (medians over the complaints; least gamma)
conditioning.<log>.[stacked.]median_tole: median of sqrt(gamma / Gamma): Prop. prop:cond bounds largest-first at tolerance c by OPT at tolerance c times this factor
conditioning.<log>.[stacked.]median_shar: share of the T (T - 1) / 2 pairs with <w_i, w_j> < 0 (signed), over the complaints
conditioning.<log>.[stacked.]median_most: median over the complaints of the least pairwise cosine
conditioning.<log>.[stacked.]median_nu /: vertex cover number of the graph of negative pairs (exact)
conditioning.<log>.median_n_edits_with_n: median number of edits with <psi_i, k_q> < 0 at the last prompt key
conditioning.<log>.share_negative_pairs_: share of pairs with <u_i, u_j> < 0 (log level)
conditioning.<log>.T / one_over_T: number of edits; the bound gamma <= 1/T of the hard instances
rollback.<log>.[stacked.]c<c>.median_lf: deletions (of T) of largest-norm-first, first-order greedy (adaptive), best-improvement greedy, and of the best of the rules, median over all complaints, criterion ||r|| <= c ||D||
rollback.<log>.[stacked.]c<c>.median_lb: lower bound of Prop. prop:cond, max(1, mu(c^2 ||D||^2 / gamma)) <= OPT_c
rollback.<log>.[stacked.]c<c>.median_<ru: per-complaint ratio rule / lower bound: median and maximum over all complaints
rollback.<log>.[stacked.]c<c>.median_lf_: median of mu(c^2 ||D||^2 / Gamma), the upper bound of Prop. prop:cond on largest-first
rollback.<log>.[stacked.]c<c>.n_<rule>_d: complaints on which the rule deletes all T edits
rollback.<log>.[stacked.]c<c>.n_need_mor: number of complaints with OPT_c > N: at least / at most (bounds + optimum jobs within the budget); optall_: with every finished optimum job
rollback.<log>.[stacked.]c<c>.n_lf_more_: complaints on which the rule deletes more than N edits
rollback.<log>.[stacked.]c<c>.opt_n_comp: complaints reached by the optimum code within the budget of 40 minutes of CPU time per log (seeded order) / of them with a certified optimum (LB* = UB*)
rollback.<log>.[stacked.]c<c>.opt_median: medians of LB* and UB* (OPT_c in [LB*, UB*]) over the reached complaints
rule / OPT_c over the certified complaints
medians of rule / UB* and rule / LB* over all reached complaints: the median of rule / OPT_c lies between them
the same bracket for (lower bound of Prop. prop:cond) / OPT_c
rollback.<log>.[stacked.]c<c>.optall_*: the opt_ quantities over EVERY finished optimum job (for a log whose run exceeded the budget before it was stopped this is a longer prefix of the same seeded order)
rollback.<log>.optimum_run.*: budget (CPU minutes), CPU minutes spent, over_budget, MILP limit, complaints within the budget / finished
capacity.<log>.group_size_min / _max / _: protection group = every position of the edit's request sequence (prompt + target): number of keys and numerical rank r_i
capacity.<log>.prefix_z / prefix_z_bitwi: shared-prefix dimension z used (leading positions whose keys agree within 10 % in all sequences) / leading positions bitwise equal in all T sequences / number of bitwise-distinct copies of that prefix
capacity.<log>.sstar_Z / kept_pred: s*_Z of Thm. thm:capacity under GP/Z for a = 1 and T - s*_Z, the predicted number of protectable edits
capacity.<log>.sstar_z0 / kept_pred_z0: the same with z = 0 (plain general position)
capacity.<log>.kept_feasible (kept_feasi: measured: the largest n such that a correction protecting the n smallest groups exists for EVERY complaint (both key definitions; per-complaint extremes) / T minus it
capacity.<log>.rank_at_kept / rank_pred_: rank of the protected span at n = kept_feasible, its GP/Z prediction, and the n at which the span fills the key space
capacity.<log>.stacked.kept_pred_min / _: T - s*_Z with a = A (stacked complaint keys), extremes over the complaints
capacity.<log>.needed_set.*: the same with the needed set (positions 0 .. len - 2) as protection group
capacity.<log>.K_ans.* / K_last.*: protecting only the answer-predicting keys / only the last prompt key of every edit: number of keys, rank of their span, protectable edits by the law (z = 0) and measured (all T at once), complaints that stay repairable, median escape ||(I - P) k_q|| / ||k_q|| of the complaint's last prompt key
